extension_contract.compatibility_rule: Extensions must declare supported ANPOS protocol ranges and fail closed when the active protocol is outside that range.
extension_contract.isolation_rule: An extension must not silently mutate canonical core semantics, project-owned application state, or another extension namespace.
extension_contract.evidence_rule: Extension installation or configuration presence is never completion evidence for a project capability.
extension_contract.removal_rule: Removing an extension must preserve project-generated source/data unless an explicit project migration authorizes otherwise.

schema_evolution.additive_compatible_change: may remain within the same extension major when consumers can ignore new optional fields
schema_evolution.breaking_change: requires a new extension major and migration path
schema_evolution.core_schema_breaking_change: requires an ANPOS protocol release and migration

registry_rule: Future extensions are registered only after validation of identity, compatibility, entrypoints, schema references, migration behavior, deprecation behavior and evidence boundaries.
